QUESTIONS

Frequently asked questions.

Is scuba diving suitable for beginners?+

Beginner participation may be possible depending on the activity, instructor assessment, weather and sea conditions and applicable requirements.

Can non-swimmers participate?+

Non-swimmer participation may be available for certain experiences, subject to instructor assessment, activity requirements and sea conditions. Please confirm before booking.

What is included in the packages?+

All three listed packages include scuba diving, snorkeling, boat ride, underwater photography, gear equipment and refreshments & snacks.

What are the current package prices?+

10+ people: ₹4,000 per person. 5+ people: ₹4,500 per person. 1 person: ₹5,000 per person.

How do I book?+

Choose a package above and use the booking form, or contact West Coast Adventure directly on WhatsApp at +91 91805 45663.

What happens if weather or sea conditions are unsuitable?+

Activities are subject to weather, sea conditions and operational availability. Contact the team for the latest conditions and arrangements.

What are the age and health requirements?+

Please confirm the current requirements with the business before booking, as suitability can depend on the participant and activity.
